title: A tree has at most one perfect matching
statement: Let $G$ be a tree on a finite vertex set — a connected, acyclic simple graph. Then any two perfect matchings of $G$ coincide; that is, $G$ has at most one perfect matching.
hypotheses_covered: G is a tree (connected and acyclic)
M is a perfect matching of G
M' is a perfect matching of G
